content.instruction: Write a job application. You are applying for a President of the European Commission position. Tell about your experience in EU policy leadership, building compromises between member states, and strategic development of the Union. Describe your vision for Europe's future and how you would strengthen the Union's role as a global actor. Length about 450 words.
